products.name: OnFinance AI
products.tagline: Research workspace for listed Indian housing finance companies.
products.target_model: GLM 5.3 on Cloudflare Workers AI (onfinance_hfc: orchestrator and specialist; onfinance_hfc_vm: Kimi K2.6 orchestrator, GLM 5.3 specialist; image reading GLM 5.3 Flash on both)

stamped: state/application/<app_id>/ filled against all four schemas
mold builds on VM (npm run build, typecheck)
lanes_passing: all five lanes pass on the stamped app

every lane has a harness: accessibility (a11y.mjs) and responsiveness (responsive.mjs) built 2026-09-08, load (testing/load/stress.py) built 2026-09-09 (mold_v1-024); functional and context are the mold's own suites

for an app on its own server (target vm_remote, mold_v1-078): the lanes grade infrastructure.vm_remote.production_url, and the functional lane's tool.python row passes (the deployed agent really ran python3 in its sandbox; a tool result carried the computed line)
deployed: production URL on Vercel (target: vercel); target: vm verifies an app's database locally and does not serve it (mold_v1-020, infra/vm/README.md)
secrets present by name only in state
the app's inference provider configured and smoke-tested (Cloudflare Workers AI running the models in application.model.roles, or Claude Sonnet 5 on the Vercel AI Gateway)

or, on a server of the customer's own (target vm_remote, docs/RUNBOOK.md §9): provision.py <app> --qualify-remote accepted the host (/dev/kvm, 8 GB / 4 vCPU, 20 GB free, Ubuntu 24.04, no Docker), provision.py <app> --deploy-remote ended `deployed: https://<domain>`, and infrastructure.vm_remote.health reads workflow/api/web 200 with kvm ok (API as a non-root user in group kvm, only ports 22/80/443 listening, six cron timers, env file mode 600)

vm_remote only: the mold carries the three off-Vercel switches (mold_v1-073 storage driver, mold_v1-074 service identity, mold_v1-151 the upstream sandbox setting); --deploy-remote refuses a source that lacks any of them (.claude/scripts/lib/vm_remote.py MOLD_SWITCHES)
released: onboarding path works end to end on a stamped app (docs/RUNBOOK.md: intake, provision, the customer credentials (five on Cloudflare Workers AI, four on the Vercel AI Gateway, the Google client id counted once; plus EXA_API_KEY / BROWSERBASE_API_KEY when web search / the browser are on), deploy, clone.py configure, emailed-code sign-in, then the mold's operator:onboard-self / operator:new-org / operator:new-customer)
docs + pricing/packaging decided (docs/PRODUCTS.md; pricing still a placeholder)
budget of inference cost per workspace known (docs/COST_MODEL.md: prices fetched, volumes measured from automation_runs rather than placeholders)
vm_remote only: the server's monthly price is in docs/COST_MODEL.md §7 for the plan actually used, and what a redeploy costs in downtime (the build is in place) has been told to the customer
